subject: [hw] T01 -> V02: trace hooks and stop semantics
body: My n2a32_trace.c defines strong n2a32_trace_insn/hostcall/mmio. Please keep weak no-op definitions in your stub so both link orders work, and call them only when c->trace != NULL. Questions: (1) does n2a32_run stop with STOP_LIMIT after exactly c->ilimit instructions? (2) does stop_insn hold the faulting/undefined encoding for UNDEF? (3) n2a32_call: after it returns, is c->stop N2A32_STOP_RETURN? I will rely on these in fuzz/diff. No answer needed if the obvious reading holds; I will adapt to the code once emu/n2a32_core.c lands.
